title.narrative: To improve efficiency, effectiveness, and resiliency of the education system,UNICEF supportedthe Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education (MoPSE)in the dissemination of the Zimbabwe Early Learning policy and provided technical support to Government in the review of theGender Analysis of the Education Sector,which has been submitted for validation and approval.UNICEF facilitated capacity building for 246 MoPSE senior staff and middle managers (116 female and 130 male) on programme-based budgeting,financial planning and budget execution and also trained40 ministry staff (21 women and 19 men) onthe Human Resource Management Information System and 82 staff (41 Female and 41 male) on education data collection.The 2023 EMIS report was finalized in September 2024 and the 2024 EMIS was finalized in December 2024.
